sentences.text: 1. This appeal has been filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 being aggrieved by the order dated 23.09.2015 passed in Claim Case No. 19/2024 for enhancement of compensation.
2. On early occasion i.e. 10.09.2024, no one was present on behalf of appellant.
Today also, no one is appeared for the appellant.
It seems that the appellant has lost his interest in prosecuting the matter.
3. Accordingly, present appeal stands dismissed for want of prosecution.
